ICS 73.120CED 551. SCOPEThis standard (Part 1) lays down the requirements regarding material, dimensions, construction and finish of industrial woven wire cloth screen used for industrial screening purposes. It applies to industrial woven wire cloth screen of aperture size from 16 mm to 0.02 mm with square aperture.2. REFERENCESThe standards given below contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the edition indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.IS 5742 : 2022 Glossary of terms relating to Industrial screen and screening (first revision)IS 18061 : 2022 Selection of aperture size, percentage open area and wire diameter combination for industrial screens - Guidelines
